en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a European hillside town. In the foreground are trees and a rail line; a low train or tram runs along the bottom edge. Above it rise dense trees and villas on the slope. Dominating the skyline are an ornate multi-storey institutional building on the left, a tall church tower with a steep spire in the center, and another tower-like structure to its left. A very tall factory chimney with decorative brick patterning stands to the right, near a hillside building marked as a restaurant. The overall scene mixes industrial and historic architecture.
